prohibited: treating SS64 as a binary repository

native_resolution_order: binary already present in the target rootfs
official distribution/package provider staged by the build or installer
compatibility shim with explicit provider-missing status

binary_staging.source: target rootfs or official package provider

native_build.policy: Only commands implemented in the native source are marked native. Other catalogued commands must resolve to a staged provider or remain explicitly unavailable; catalog membership never implies an executable exists.

isa_execution.scope: The sample lookup API exposes worked binary/hex encodings. It is not a complete ISA decoder, encoder, emulator, JIT, or hardware execution backend.
isa_execution.foreign_execution: Requires a validated architecture-specific decoder/lowering backend or a compatible emulation runtime; unsupported instructions must fail closed.
